route: Estimator calibration on a complete 35-parameter Hessian problem
independent_checker: Full-batch finite differences match exact Hessian directional actions.
negative_control: Using the same minibatch removes the batch-switch term and returns a proxy on the Hessian scale.
primary_reference_audit: arXiv:1905.11881 Appendix H.3 Equation (17) evaluates gradients on the same full or 10%-dataset along an interpolation path, not on changing minibatches.
limitation: This calibration diagnoses the estimator but is not a named-model reproduction and cannot verify or falsify Section 3.2.
